GOOD TO KNOW

A few straight answers.

Is it really a one-time payment?+

The website build and the extras you select have a one-time price. There’s no required ongoing maintenance plan. Hosting, your domain, and third-party tools can have their own recurring charges; we agree those separately before you commit. Payment timing is set out in your quote.

What if I want to change something later?+

Get in touch with what you need: a new page, fresh content, a feature or a fix. We assess the work and agree a price before starting. Any correction or support obligations for the original delivery are set out in your project agreement.

Will my website look exactly like the demo?+

The demos are starting points. Your logo, colours, images and content make the design yours. Larger layout changes or custom features are scoped and priced before we build. The demo businesses, menus and rooms are fictional examples.

What do I need to provide?+

Your logo or business name, approved text, images you have permission to use, and practical details such as opening hours and contact information. Copywriting and content entry are available as extras. Translations and third-party accounts are supplied by you.

How long does a website take?+

Typical builds take 2–3 weeks for a one-page site, 3–4 weeks for business, hospitality and booking sites, and 4–6 weeks for a small shop. Your quote confirms the actual schedule, based on scope, availability and when your content is ready.

Can I use my own hosting and domain?+

Yes. We’ll check that they support the agreed site and work out the launch and handover with you. If you need help choosing hosting or setting up your domain, include that in your brief. Provider costs are separate from the build.
